reasoning_content: The `lib` directory only contains README, not the jar files! So the jars were extracted elsewhere — maybe there were multiple top-level `lib` entries in the zip, and I only moved one of them. Let me check whether there's another lib directory left over in /opt, and search for the jars.

action.command: cd /opt && ls -d */ | head -20; find /opt -maxdepth 3 -name "liquibase-core*.jar" 2>/dev/null | head -3; find /opt -maxdepth 2 -name "*.jar" 2>/dev/null | head -5

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /opt && ls -d */ | head -20; find /opt -maxdepth 3 -name \"liquibase-core*.jar\" 2>/dev/null | head -3; find /opt -maxdepth 2 -name \"*.jar\" 2>/dev/null | head -5", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Find where Liquibase jars extracted"}
